WinDV 2.0 is a modernized WinDV with a new Windows 11 interface. It captures DV video from a camcorder over FireWire and records it back to tape.

## Download

- **WinDV-2.0.0-x64.zip**: for 64-bit Windows (almost every PC).
- **WinDV-2.0.0-x86.zip**: for 32-bit Windows.

Unzip anywhere and run `WinDV.exe`. Nothing needs installing: .NET and the Windows App SDK are included. Requires Windows 10 or 11.

## What's new

- **New interface** with Windows 11 styling (Mica, light and dark themes).
- **VCR-style controls**: Rewind, Play, Pause, Stop and Fast-forward drive the camcorder, and the preview follows the tape. Fast-forward and Rewind wind a stopped tape and cue (search with a picture) while it plays. A separate red **REC** button starts and stops writing AVI files.
- A **Signal** indicator shows whether video is arriving from the camcorder.
- A settings screen, drag-and-drop for files, and keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Space play, Ctrl+P pause, Esc stop, Ctrl+Left/Right rewind/fast-forward, Ctrl+R REC).
- Native 64-bit build, Unicode file names, and many long-standing crashes and bugs fixed (see the README).
- Your existing WinDV settings carry over, and capture file naming and the command line (`WinDV capture ...`, `WinDV record ...`) are unchanged.

## Tips

- Put the camcorder in **VCR/VTR (tape) mode**. In camera or stills mode it won't appear as a capture device.
- Only one program can use the camcorder at a time, so close other copies of WinDV first.

## Thanks

WinDV was created by Petr Mourek (2002-2003, http://windv.mourek.cz), who generously shared its source. His capture engine is still at the heart of WinDV 2. Thank you, Petr.
